```yaml
name: Test Flake

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "flake.nix"
      - "flake.lock"
      - ".github/workflows/test-flake.yml"
      - "rust-toolchain.toml"
      - "**/Cargo.toml"
      - "Cargo.lock"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "flake.nix"
      - "flake.lock"
      - ".github/workflows/test-flake.yml"
      - "rust-toolchain.toml"
      - "**/Cargo.toml"
      - "Cargo.lock"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-flake:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Nix
        uses: DeterminateSystems/nix-installer-action@v13

      - name: Test flake
        run: |
          nix flake check
          nix develop --accept-flake-config -c true
        continue-on-error: true
```
